_comment: Recipes. type: shaped (pattern rows + key), shapeless (ingredients list), smelt (input -> output, ticks), spellcraft (station recipe). ADR 0023 (Vintage Story early game): knap (input, 8x8 pattern, row = z, column = x, # = keep), clayform (input, layers bottom first, each 8x8, # = clay), kiln (pit kiln: input -> output), melt (firepit: count x input + vessel -> output vessel), cast (molten vessel on a mold -> output, returns the vessel), sift (sieve: input -> output with chance; same input = one loot table). Ingredient = item id or '#tag'. Minecraft semantics: shaped recipes may be translated anywhere in the grid and mirrored.
